summary: Iteration 18: Tested P0 accounting logic fix for Bahi Khata MFI — disbursement journal entry (3-line), EMI collection journal entry (2-line), Bid (monthly aggregate cashbook) structure and balance. All 26 backend tests pass.

feature_tests.disbursement_entry_exists: PASS — loan_disbursement journal entry created on loan creation with reference_id = loan_id
feature_tests.disbursement_entry_has_3_lines: PASS — disbursement entry has exactly 3 lines (Dr Loans Portfolio, Cr Cash, Cr Interest Income)
feature_tests.disbursement_loans_portfolio_dr: PASS — Loans Portfolio Dr = P + round(P*17/103, 2). For P=10000: Dr=11650.49
feature_tests.disbursement_cash_cr: PASS — Cash Cr = P (principal only). For P=10000: Cr=10000.0
feature_tests.disbursement_interest_income_cr: PASS — Interest Income Cr = round(P*17/103, 2). For P=10000: Cr=1650.49
feature_tests.disbursement_entry_balanced: PASS — Total Dr = Total Cr in all disbursement entries
feature_tests.emi_entry_exists: PASS — emi_collection journal entry created on EMI collection
feature_tests.emi_entry_has_2_lines: PASS — EMI entry has exactly 2 lines (no interest split / old 3-line format eliminated)
feature_tests.emi_cash_dr_equals_full_emi: PASS — Cash Dr = full EMI amount (not just principal portion)
feature_tests.emi_loans_portfolio_cr_equals_full_emi: PASS — Loans Portfolio Cr = full EMI amount
feature_tests.emi_no_interest_income_line: PASS — EMI entry contains NO Interest Income line
feature_tests.bid_returns_200: PASS — GET /api/accounts/bid returns 200 with illaka_id + month params
feature_tests.bid_has_required_fields: PASS — Response has month, opening_balance, dr_totals, cr_totals, total_dr, total_cr, closing_balance
feature_tests.bid_emi_collections_in_dr: PASS — dr_totals contains emi_total section with positive total
feature_tests.bid_emi_collections_at_full_cash_amount: PASS — EMI Collections misal breakdown shows full cash received amounts
feature_tests.bid_interest_income_in_dr_from_disbursem: PASS — Interest Income in Dr side comes from loan_disbursement entries only
feature_tests.bid_loans_portfolio_in_cr: PASS — Loans Portfolio in cr_totals = P+I for loans disbursed this month
feature_tests.bid_balance_equation: PASS — closing_balance = opening_balance + total_dr - total_cr (to 2 decimal places)
feature_tests.old_3line_emi_entries_at_full_cash_dr: PASS — Existing 3-line EMI entries appear at full cash_dr amount in Bid (backward compatibility)
feature_tests.emi_entries_no_contribution_to_interest_: PASS — EMI collection entries do not add to Interest Income in Bid Dr side
feature_tests.test_loan_interest_matches_formula: PASS — Actual interest in disbursement entry matches formula for test loan (P=10000, I=1650.49)

critical_code_review_comments: OK: helpers.py book_loan_disbursement correctly implements 3-line entry: Dr Loans Portfolio (P+I), Cr Cash (P), Cr Interest Income (round(P*17/103, 2))
OK: loans.py _book_emi_collection correctly implements 2-line entry for non-Gyal loans: Dr Cash (full EMI), Cr Loans Portfolio (full EMI). No interest split.

OK: accounts.py get_bid correctly picks cash_dr from emi_collection entries (full amount, not split), interest from loan_disbursement credit lines only, Loans Portfolio from loan_disbursement debit lines
OK: Bid balance equation closing = opening + total_dr - total_cr is mathematically correct — interest terms cancel out giving real cash position
OK: Backward-compat handled — old 3-line EMI entries (if any) still use cash_dr for Bid EMI Collections total
NOTE: routes/loans.py is 627 lines, routes/accounts.py is 922 lines — accounts.py is well over 700 line limit; could be split into accounts_bid.py, accounts_entries.py, accounts_expense.py modules
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Accounting_Customer KYC + 1 loan (principal=10000, illaka=Delhi) with 1 EMI collected. These are in the current month (2026-02). Loan ID is in the DB.
